summary: Iteration 5, frontend only, viewport 375x667. Tested the ChatGPT-style chat chrome and Presenter Mode. All 7 requested flows pass. Sidebar: chat-menu-button opens chat-sidebar (Search/New chat/Library/Apps/Connected Wayfair/history/profile 'Pat Vaughan · Plus', or 'Google AI Pro' on Gemini). Tapping the backdrop closes it. sidebar-new-chat resets messages and the cart widget and shows 'What can I help with?' again. sidebar-apps closes the sidebar and opens app-picker. The model label reads 'ChatGPT 5.4' or 'Gemini 3 Flash'. chat-new-button resets the chat. Suggestions chat-suggestion-0..2 render. Wayfair chip: composer-app-remove hides the chip and the subtitle changes to 'Tap + to connect the Wayfair app.'. chat-plus-button opens app-picker, and app-picker-wayfair toggles the chip and closes the picker. Manual chat: typing and pressing Enter or chat-send-button streams a real LLM reply with no raw markdown, assistant action icons and product-add-wf-arnav-sectional. Suggestion-1 returns the velvet sofa; adding it shows cart-count '1 item' and $699.99; check-offers-button opens citi-signin-step with the cart ref. Presenter offer (ChatGPT): picker -> presenter-start-offer -> auto chat (3.3s) -> add (8.7s) -> sign-in (12s) -> Face ID -> lookup (17s) -> offer-available $125 -> offer-activated -> cart-offer-activated (27s) -> done-step with done-credit '$125.00 back will post to your Citi statement' at 31s. The kicker moved STEP 1/5 through 5/5. The whole run took about 33s, not the expected 60-90s. Presenter no-offer: loveseat -> no-matching-offer with reason 'needs $500+ ... $389.99' -> cart-no-offer -> done-step, no done-credit, 'Citi offer: None'. Pause/resume: pausing on the chat step for 9s blocked the auto-add, and pausing on sign-in for 7s blocked Face ID; resume continued both times. Exit: presenter-exit-button hides the commentary and the flow stays on the offers step (not activated after 8s). The presenter-button stop during chat hides the commentary and stops the auto-add. Gemini: the sidebar, picker and presenter (offer, $125) all work. No page errors. I fixed one bug: the composer-app-remove Pressable had a 0x0 box on web, which made it untappable or flaky.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: the Pressable around the 14px close icon rendered with a 0x0 box on web, so taps were unreliable and Playwright reported 'Element is outside of the viewport'. hitSlop is not honored on web. I added styles.chipClose (24x24, centered). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/steps/ChatStep.tsx:155

appOn is cosmetic only. With the chip removed ('Tap + to connect the Wayfair app.'), sending 'Show me a velvet sofa' still returns Wayfair products (product-add-wf-etta-velvet), because send() ignores appOn. The sidebar 'Connected · Wayfair · On' row is also hard-coded and stays 'On' after removal. Reference: ChatStep.tsx:46-71, ChatChrome.tsx:43-48

restart() does not reset appOn, a local state inside ChatStep. If the chip was removed earlier, the presenter demo plays with no chip and the subtitle 'Tap + to connect the Wayfair app.' while Wayfair products still appear, which contradicts itself in front of viewers. Reset appOn to true on new chat or presenter start, for example by lifting the state or keying ChatStep by chatId. Reference: shop.tsx:115-132

issues: The full run takes about 33-37s and each step is shown for only 3-5s. The 2-3 sentence narration, and the LLM reply on step 1 (product added about 5s after the reply), are hard for an audience to read. Consider longer per-step dwell, for example 6-8s, or making it proportional to the narration length.
The presenter card (about 130px) plus header, stepper and protocol panel leaves little room for the content area at 375x667. The kicker 'PRESENTER · OFFER AVAILABLE · STEP 3/5' wraps onto 2 lines.
The narration says '$389 loveseat' and '$1,249 sectional' while the UI shows $389.99 and $1,249.99.
presenter-pause-button and presenter-exit-button are 32x32, below the 44pt minimum.
chat-plus-button and chat-send-button are 36x36, below the 44pt touch target.
The assistant message action icons (copy, thumbs, speaker, refresh) are decorative and do nothing when tapped. That is fine for a prototype but could confuse people during a demo.

test_report_links: Playwright scripts run inline via browser_automation (no new pytest)
action_items: Reset the Wayfair chip (appOn) to on during restart and presenter start, for example by keying ChatStep by chatId or lifting appOn into shop.tsx

Decide whether removing the Wayfair chip should actually disconnect the app: either skip Wayfair products when appOn is false, or treat the chip as purely visual and make the sidebar 'On' row reflect its state
Optionally lengthen the presenter dwell per step (it currently finishes in about 33s) so the narration can be read
Raise presenter control buttons (32px) and the composer plus/send buttons (36px) to 44px touch targets
critical_code_review_comments: Presenter step 0 adds the scenario product even if the LLM never suggested it or returned an error (last.error). This is a deliberate fallback, but the cart then holds an item that is not shown in the chat.
If the user types a message while the presenter is paused at step 0 and then resumes, the presenter adds the scenario product regardless of the reply.
After the presenter reaches the done step, presenting stays set (stop icon and pause button still shown). Consider auto-ending the presenter or offering a 'Replay' button.
Chat sessions created from the UI (chat-*) persist in chat_messages with no TTL.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 7 requested flows pass. 1 touch-target bug fixed; 2 low/medium state-consistency issues remain

seed_data_creation: None. The run created 4 carts and 2 transactions; all were deleted by cart_ref (diffed against a snapshot taken before the run). The DB is back to baseline: 1 cart, 1 pre-existing non-seed txn, 10 seed txns. Agents unchanged (chatgpt/gemini enabled 2000, perplexity disabled 100).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env. Sidebar and app-picker use Reanimated entering animations: wait about 1.2s after opening, or use dispatch_event('click') on sidebar-apps and sidebar-new-chat, otherwise Playwright reports 'outside of viewport'. A presenter run takes about 35s end to end. Use /tmp/snap_iter5.py before|cleanup to snapshot and clean carts.
rca_of_issue: composer-app-remove: on react-native-web, a Pressable with no size around an Ionicons glyph inside the row chip collapsed to 0x0, and hitSlop is not implemented on web. Fixed with an explicit 24x24 style.
